normal.name: Crossplay Guide
normal.text: Is Stardew Valley crossplay? Only on computers. Windows, Mac and Linux players on Steam, GOG and the Xbox app can share a farm. Consoles only play with the same console. Phones have a hidden, experimental way to join a PC farm. https://crossplayguide.com/games/stardew-valley/
normal.media: image: Stardew Valley: computers only. Windows, Mac and Linux farm together; consoles stay with their own kind.
